_comment: Auto area (I3). Source of truth for People member cards (grids: ra/grad/intern/postdoc/alumni). Edited by qs-kb Slack /home-member (PI only) and the in-page admin publish. Rendered by js/auto-sections.js. I4: only PI-approved member info is published here.

members.name: Sooyoung Choi
members.desc: Received M.S. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Pennsylvania. Joined the lab as Research Associate in March 2026. Research interests include 2D superconductors and twist angle-dependent electronic properties in 2D heterostructures.

members.name: Wonchan Lee
members.desc: Joined as research assistant in October 2024, transitioned to Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. program in March 2025. Research focuses on quantum phase transitions in 2D transistors and low-power computing technologies leveraging novel quantum phenomena.

members.name: Yunjung Cho
members.desc: Joined as research assistant in November 2024, transitioned to Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. program in March 2025. Research: (1) Large-area epitaxy of 2D semiconductors; (2) 0D quantum dot–TMD heterostructure fabrication.

members.name: Inbae Song
members.desc: Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. student since March 2025, started as undergraduate intern in January 2025. Research: growth of 2D transition metal tellurides via thermal CVD.

members.name: Kangpyo Cho
members.desc: Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. student since March 2025, research assistant since February 2025. Focuses on growth of 2D ferroelectric materials for quantum-engineered logic and memory applications.

members.name: Jihwan Jeon
members.desc: Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. student since September 2025, research assistant since April 2025. Focuses on wafer-scale synthesis of 2D III-VI compound semiconductors for single-photon emitters and ferroelectric memory applications.

members.name: Chaehui Lim
members.desc: Master-PhD Combined Program student since September 2025. Research focuses on MOCVD-based synthesis of lateral in-plane 2D heterostructures for quantum information science applications.

members.name: Kyungwu Kwon
members.desc: Undergraduate intern since March 2025, transitioning to graduate student in March 2026. Research on synthesis of 2D topological semimetals and semiconductors for nanoelectronics.

members.name: Yerin So
members.desc: Physics undergraduate at Sookmyung Women's University, research intern since August 2025, graduate studies starting March 2026. Research: 2D superconductors and fundamental physical properties for superconducting qubit applications.

members.name: Seohee Park
members.desc: Undergraduate intern since September 2025. Research: synthesizing 2D ferroelectric materials and fabricating devices for next-generation semiconductor applications.

members.name: Taeyoung Jeon
members.desc: Chemical Engineering undergraduate. Research: MOCVD-based synthesis of 2D heterostructures and their applicability.

members.name: Sungwoo Yoon
members.desc: Chemical Engineering undergraduate. Research: wafer-scale synthesis of PtTe₂ via TCVD for next-generation semiconductor interconnects and spintronics.

members.name: Minseok Kim
members.desc: Undergraduate intern since March 2026. Research: quantum transport in 2D ferroelectric devices and low-power circuit design.

members.name: Minseo Kim
members.desc: Energy undergraduate, intern since April 2026. Research: CVD synthesis of 2D heterostructures for low-power, high-performance computing.

members.name: Minseong Choi
members.desc: Undergraduate intern since March 2026. Research: growth and characterization of 2D layered materials for energy and electronic applications.
